text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale Lakeside holds 12 tablets of zolpidem tartrate 12.5 mg with a daily use of 2.2, yielding 5.4 days of supply. Corvale East holds 216 tablets with 34.8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 135 tablets with 16.6 days on hand and is not part of the recommended transfer.

Why (FDA record): FDA's public shortage database shows no active shortage signal for zolpidem tartrate from the Sandoz Inc. manufacturing plant that supplies all three Corvale sites.

Our position: Internal redistribution can resolve the low supply at Lakeside without external purchasing. Corvale East has sufficient inventory to spare units while maintaining a two-week buffer.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 tablets from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — Corvale East retains approximately two weeks of supply; Lakeside reaches approximately 14 days. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Notify the buyer to monitor FDA shortage listings and secondary supplier availability weekly. Approval: pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Transfers from Corvale General (excluded per current plan). Purchases from A-S Medication Solutions, ACI Healthcare USA, Inc., or Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (none appear on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no identifiable plant).
